relationships.subject: Alox15 Leu353Phe knock-in
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that Alox15 knock-in mice are strongly protected from the development of inflammatory symptoms in the dextran sodium sulfate colitis model when the loss of body weight was used as major readout parameter.

relationships.subject: Alox15 Leu353Phe knock-in
relationships.evidence_quote: At day 8 of DSS treatment iNOS expression was (Fig. 2D) significantly higher in wildtype mice than in Alox15-KI animals

relationships.subject: Alox15 Leu353Phe knock-in
relationships.evidence_quote: Alox15-KI mice (Fig. 5D) show elevated 17-HDHA tissue concentrations when compared with wildtype controls independent of the time point of the disease.

key_findings: Functionally humanized Alox15 (Leu353Phe) knock-in mice were protected from DSS colitis weight loss but not from Freund's adjuvant paw edema.
Colon resolvin D5 was elevated in KI mice and may contribute to protection.
